description: Map ClinVar ATP1A2 variants onto the alpha2 protein and test whether pathogenic missense cluster in transmembrane helices
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, re, time, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def gql(q, tries=6):
    for a in range(tries):
        try:
            r = requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api", json={"query":q}, timeout=180)
            if r.status_code==200 and r.text.strip().startswith("{"): return r.json()
        except Exception: pass
        time.sleep(6)
    raise RuntimeError("fail")

j = gql('{gene(gene_symbol:"ATP1A2",reference_genome:GRCh38){clinvar_variants{variant_id clinical_significance major_consequence gold_stars hgvsc hgvsp}}}')
CV = pd.DataFrame(j["data"]["gene"]["clinvar_variants"])
print("ClinVar variants:", len(CV))

# UniProt P50993 (AT1A2_HUMAN) features
u = requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/P50993.json", timeout=60).json()
seq = u["sequence"]["value"]; L = len(seq)
print("UniProt P50993 length:", L)
feats = []
for f in u.get("features", []):
    t = f["type"]
    if t in ("Transmembrane","Topological domain","Domain","Region","Binding site","Active site","Modified residue"):
        loc = f["location"]
        feats.append({"type":t, "desc":f.get("description",""),
                      "start":loc["start"].get("value"), "end":loc["end"].get("value")})
F = pd.DataFrame(feats)
tm = F[F["type"]=="Transmembrane"].dropna(subset=["start","end"])
print("transmembrane helices:", len(tm))
print(F[F["type"].isin(("Domain","Region","Active site","Binding site"))].head(20).to_string(index=False))

# residue numbers from hgvsp
aa3 = {'Ala','Arg','Asn','Asp','Cys','Gln','Glu','Gly','His','Ile','Leu','Lys','Met','Phe','Pro','Ser','Thr','Trp','Tyr','Val','Ter'}
def res_of(h):
    if not isinstance(h,str): return np.nan
    m = re.search(r'p\.([A-Z][a-z]{2})(\d+)', h)
    return int(m.group(2)) if m and m.group(1) in aa3 else np.nan
CV["res"] = CV["hgvsp"].apply(res_of)
CV["path"] = CV["clinical_significance"].isin(["Pathogenic","Likely pathogenic","Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic"])
CV["benign"] = CV["clinical_significance"].isin(["Benign","Likely benign","Benign/Likely benign"])
mis = CV[CV["major_consequence"]=="missense_variant"].dropna(subset=["res"])
pm = mis[mis["path"]]; bm = mis[mis["benign"]]
print(f"\nmissense with residue: {len(mis)}  P/LP: {len(pm)}  B/LB: {len(bm)}")

# is pathogenic missense enriched in transmembrane segments?
tm_mask = np.zeros(L+1, bool)
for _,r in tm.iterrows(): tm_mask[int(r["start"]):int(r["end"])+1] = True
tm_frac = tm_mask.sum()/L
a = int(tm_mask[pm["res"].astype(int)].sum()); b = len(pm)-a
c = int(tm_mask[bm["res"].astype(int)].sum()); d = len(bm)-c
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
orr, p = fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]])
print(f"TM residues cover {tm_frac*100:.1f}% of protein ({tm_mask.sum()}/{L} aa)")
print(f"P/LP missense in TM: {a}/{len(pm)} ({a/len(pm)*100:.1f}%)   B/LB missense in TM: {c}/{len(bm)} ({c/len(bm)*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"Fisher exact OR={orr:.2f}, p={p:.3g}")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13,4.2))
for _,r in tm.iterrows():
    ax.axvspan(r["start"], r["end"], color="#D9D9D9", zorder=0)
ax.hist(pm["res"], bins=np.arange(0,L+26,25), color="#C44E52", alpha=0.85, label=f"ClinVar pathogenic/likely pathogenic missense (n={len(pm)})")
ax.hist(bm["res"], bins=np.arange(0,L+26,25), color="#4C72B0", alpha=0.55, label=f"ClinVar benign/likely benign missense (n={len(bm)})")
trunc = CV[CV["major_consequence"].isin(["stop_gained","frameshift_variant"]) & CV["path"]].dropna(subset=["res"])
ax.plot(trunc["res"], np.full(len(trunc), -0.6), "v", color="k", ms=5, label=f"pathogenic truncating (n={len(trunc)})")
ax.set_xlim(0,L); ax.set_xlabel("ATP1A2 residue (UniProt P50993, 1020 aa); grey bands = transmembrane helices")
ax.set_ylabel("variant count per 25 aa")
ax.set_title("ClinVar variant distribution along the Na,K-ATPase alpha2 subunit")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
